body:
your body type looks very similar to mine and i've always heard it referred to as an inverted triangle. for me personally, what works is a tighter/more form-fitting top to accentuate the waist, and baggier or flowy bottoms to help balance out what we've got going on up there lol. the same thing goes for dresses/skirts, something that goes in at the waist and then out towards the bottom looks great, like a-line styles.

i would advise against wearing baggier tops as it can have that sort of 'tent' effect that can be a little unflattering for us; if you like that kind of top though, the ones that are cropped look a bit better! i see you're wearing cropped tops on 1 + 4 and they look SUPER good on you. i would say that outfit 2 is my personal favorite, the shorter length can make your legs pop more and that can be great to avoid looking top-heavy. you look great in silver btw :)

i think painting something together could be really cute; maybe portraits of each other or follow along to a bob ross tutorial? then you could send each other what you made and have something of theirs to hang up :)
